question.text: A body of mass 2 kg is moving along $x$-direction such that its displacement as function of time is given by $x(t)=\alpha t^{2}+\beta t+\gamma \mathrm{m}$, where $\alpha=1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}, \beta=1 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$ and $\gamma=1 \mathrm{~m}$. The work done on the body during the time interval $t=2 \mathrm{~s}$ to $t=3 \mathrm{~s}$, is $\_\_\_\_$ J.
